description: This file defines an abstract class 'ComponentMsgProcessor' for processing messages related to components within the Thingsboard server. It includes lifecycle management methods, message validation, and scheduling functionalities, serving as a base for specific component processors.

classes.name: ComponentMsgProcessor
classes.description: An abstract class for processing component-related messages, managing lifecycle states, and scheduling tasks within the Thingsboard server.

methods.name: getComponentName
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the component's name.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Abstract method to start the component processing.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Abstract method to stop the component processing.

methods.name: onPartitionChangeMsg
methods.description: Abstract method to handle partition change messages.

methods.name: onCreated
methods.description: Invokes start() when the component is created.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Handles update events by restarting the component.

methods.name: onActivate
methods.description: Handles activation events by restarting the component.

methods.name: onSuspend
methods.description: Handles suspension events by stopping the component.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Handles stop events by stopping the component.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Restarts the component by stopping and then starting it.

methods.name: checkMsgValid
methods.description: Validates a message; logs if invalid.

methods.name: checkComponentStateActive
methods.description: Checks if the component is active; throws exception if not.

methods.name: getInactiveException
methods.description: Abstract method to get exception when component is inactive.
